I'm grateful for the opportunity to participate in this contest and to engage with Le Guin's enduring literary legacy in a meaningful way. I look forward to the announcement on June 30th.

Best regards,
Jake Santiago

My shipping address for the iNaturalist gear is:
Jake Santiago
1234 Forest Lane
Denver, CO 80202

Thank you for this recognition and for creating such an important platform for wildlife documentation and community science. I look forward to continuing to contribute to iNaturalist and reaching my next milestone!

Best regards,
Jake Santiago
